description: This file contains utility functions for source code introspection and manipulation used within the PyTorch project, including functions for retrieving source code lines, normalizing indentation, and parsing function definitions. It also defines classes for source context handling relevant to TorchScript compilation.

classes.name: SourceContext
classes.description: A class extending SourceRangeFactory to store metadata about source code contexts, including source code, filename, line number, and usage of true division.

classes.name: ParsedDef
classes.description: A NamedTuple that encapsulates the parsed Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), source context, source code, filename, and line number of a function.

methods.name: tuple[list[str],int,str|None] get_source_lines_and_file( obj: Any, error_msg: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves source lines, line number, and filename for a given object, handling errors related to inaccessible source files.

methods.name: list[str] normalize_source_lines(sourcelines: list[str])
methods.description: Adjusts indentation in source lines so that function definitions and their bodies are properly aligned, facilitating parsing.

methods.name: make_source_context(*args)
methods.description: Cache-enabled factory function to create SourceContext instances.

methods.name: fake_range()
methods.description: Creates a dummy SourceContext range with minimal source code, possibly for testing or placeholder purposes.

methods.name: parse_def(fn)
methods.description: Parses a function object to extract its source code, AST, and related metadata, ensuring the source contains exactly one top-level function definition.

methods.name: __init__( self, source, filename, file_lineno, leading_whitespace_len, uses_true_division=True, funcname=None, )

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, source, filename, file_lineno, leading_whitespace_len, uses_true_division=True, funcname=None, )

ctags.name: get_source_lines_and_file
ctags.signature: ( obj: Any, error_msg: str | None = None, )
